```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)

library(p8105.datasets)
data("weather_df")
weather_df

```

Basic Scatterplot

```{r}
ggplot(weather_df, aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) ## no data

```
```{r}
ggplot(weather_df, aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) + 
  geom_point()

```
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point()

# labeling the plot
ggp_temp_scatterplot = 
  weather_df |>
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point()

```
Little bit fancier :)
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .25) +
  geom_smooth(se = F)
```
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = name), alpha = .25) + # assign color specific for the point not the smooth or any others in the plot. 
  geom_smooth(se = F)
```
Show faceting

```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .25) +
  facet_grid(.~name)

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .25) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(name))
```
Other data
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(se = F)
  facet_grid(.~ name)

weather_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = tmax, color = name)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = prcp), alpha = .5) +
  geom_smooth(se = F)
  facet_grid(.~ name)
```

Learning assessment:
```{r}
weather_df |> 
  filter(name == "CentralPark_NY") |> 
  mutate(
    tmax = tmax * (9 / 5) + 32,
    tmin = tmin * (9 / 5) + 32) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmin, y = tmax)) +
  geom_point() 
```
